name: Newton Community Education Summer Camp
description_short: Summer camps run by Newton Community Education, part of Newton Public Schools, at Newton North High School and Horace Mann Elementary School. Families pick weekly half-day (9 AM to 12 PM) or full-day (to 3:30 PM) camps for kids entering kindergarten through high school, from 3D printing and filmmaking to tennis and chess, plus a 5-week theater camp and a CIT program.
refund_policy_summary: A $10 non-refundable registration fee per session. Withdraw from a summer camp by June 1 for a refund minus a $50 cancellation fee per camp per student; no refunds after June 1. Transfers to another NCE summer class may be possible for a fee.

sources.note: NCE home page: 'Summer Camp 2027 is LIVE!'

source.title: Newton Community Education | Learning, Enrichment, & Community

warnings: This is Newton Community Education's homepage, not a summer camp page. Most of it covers adult classes, school-year kids' clubs, STEAM Saturdays, early release days, FUNtastic Fridays and NAA Basketball. Summer Camp only appears as a navigation link.

The text 'Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–5 PM / Every Week, June 29–August 21' shows up twice, out of place, inside the FUNtastic Fridays section. It looks like leftover summer camp text. June 29 was a Monday in 2026 but is a Tuesday in 2027, so these are probably the 2026 summer dates, which have already passed. No sessions were recorded from it.
No 2027 summer camp information was found on this page.
